notes.title: First Major Content Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Goober Dash Update Notes[/b]

We're thrilled to bring players our first major content update for Goober Dash! Dive into the excitement with a bunch of new cosmetics, gameplay elements, and enhancements to the custom lobby experience! Here's what's new:

[b]New Content:[/b]

Introducing 20 new Animal Themed cosmetics to collect, available at level 13! Customize your Goober with fresh looks and stand out from the crowd, including the Toucan and Polar Bear.

[b]Exciting New Gameplay Elements![/b]

🧊[b] Ice Block:[/b] Brace yourselves for slippery challenges! Navigate through levels with zero friction and master the art of control. 

✈️ [b]Jump Zone:[/b] Experience gravity-defying jumps within designated zones! Leap freely and conquer obstacles with finesse.

🎹 [b]Music Note:[/b] Get groovy with music notes that play tones when touched! 

Explore the new gameplay possibilities in the LEVEL CREATOR, to build crazier levels than ever before! 

[b]Custom Lobby Enhancements:[/b]

Revamped custom lobby experience with improvements to flow and functionality, including Random Mode: Spice up your custom gaming sessions with unpredictable twists and turns. Embrace the chaos and get into the next game with your friends FAST! 

Hope you like all the new stuff! We are already lining up the next major feature, so stay tuned!
See you out there!

- Winterpixel Team
